ui.breadcrumb.description: Accessible label for the breadcrumb navigation trail (the WAI-ARIA APG's conventional name)

ui.combobox-listbox.description: Accessible label for a ComboBox's dropdown list of suggestions

ui.combobox-trigger.description: Accessible label for the button that opens a ComboBox's suggestions dropdown

ui.loading.description: Announced by screen readers for a button showing a loading spinner

ui.new-tab-notice.description: Visually hidden suffix on links that open a new tab, announced by screen readers

ui.numberfield-decrease.description: Accessible label for a number field's decrement stepper; fieldLabel is the field's label and may be empty

ui.numberfield-increase.description: Accessible label for a number field's increment stepper; fieldLabel is the field's label and may be empty

ui.select-placeholder.description: Shown in a Select's trigger while nothing is chosen and the app supplies no placeholder

ui.select-row-action.description: Accessible label for a row-selection checkbox in a list or table; screen readers read it together with the row's content

ui.toast-region.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {# fógra} two {# fhógra} few {# fógraí} many {# notifications} other {# fógraí}}.
ui.toast-region.description: Accessible label for the notifications area; count is the number of notifications showing

ui.toast-status-error.description: Announced by screen readers before an error notification

ui.toast-status-info.description: Announced by screen readers before an informational notification

ui.toast-status-success.description: Announced by screen readers before a success notification

ui.toast-status-warning.description: Announced by screen readers before a warning notification
